where: Every wild kin battle (the default battle bed) and the attract-mode trailer duel
mood: The fight you hear a thousand times — urgent, catchy and winnable: a minor-key chase that bursts into a heroic major lift.
core_styles: A minor with a heroic lift to C major
fast syncopated sawtooth lead melody with leaping hooks
relentless pumping root-fifth eighth-note synth bass
punchy sampled battle drums with snare fills
stabbing sampled brass answering the lead
urgent exciting creature battle theme, thrilling but winnable, never scary

sections.name: Battle Start
sections.text: {a sharp percussive battle-start hit: a fast descending-then-rising chromatic run on the lead over a snare roll and brass stabs, slamming onto the downbeat of the main battle theme}

sections.name: Battle Theme
sections.text: {the main battle hook: a short leaping syncopated phrase on the sawtooth lead, then a bar of space that the brass stabs answer; the pumping bass never rests}

sections.name: Battle Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same hook again, sequenced higher, a twin lead a third below, the arpeggio busier, climbing tension on the harmonic-minor dominant}

sections.name: Heroic Lift
sections.text: {contrast: the hook turns heroic in C major, sustained brass chords, four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats, the melody climbing to a high climax — courage, we can win this}

sections.name: Battle Theme Return
sections.text: {back to A minor, the main battle hook in full force; a dominant cadence with a drum fill in the last bar slams straight back into the hook, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
